aerial.title: Kimihurura from the air
aerial.alt: Aerial view at dusk over the green hills of Kimihurura, Kigali, with Almasi Residences on a rise in the middle distance.

street.title: Arrival on KG 15 Ave
street.alt: Almasi Residences from KG 15 Ave at dusk: a stone and walnut facade with deep glass balconies behind a gatehouse and palms.

arrival.title: The porte-cochère
arrival.alt: The covered drop-off at dusk: a walnut canopy, a water wall and the glowing lobby behind a curved driveway.

lobby.title: Reception
lobby.alt: The double-height reception lobby in travertine and walnut, with a marble desk, a lounge and a ring chandelier.

pool.title: The pool deck
pool.alt: The residents’ fifteen-metre pool at blue hour, lit from below, with loungers and the building rising behind.

restaurant.title: The restaurant
restaurant.alt: The residents’ restaurant: olive leather banquettes, marble tables laid for dinner and a backlit bar.

gym.title: The fitness studio
gym.alt: The fitness studio with strength equipment and treadmills facing full-height glass and the hills at dusk.

wellness.title: Sauna and massage
wellness.alt: The wellness suite: a glass-fronted cedar sauna beside a calm massage room in travertine.

cowork.title: The co-working lounge
cowork.alt: The residents’ co-working lounge with a long oak table, brass lamps and walnut-slat walls.

parking.title: Basement parking
parking.alt: The basement car park in board-formed concrete, with EV charging and a walnut-lined lift lobby.

living-2br.title: A two-bedroom living room
living-2br.alt: A two-bedroom living and dining room at sunset, opening onto a balcony above the Kigali hills.

two-kitchen.title: A two-bedroom kitchen
two-kitchen.alt: An open kitchen with a marble island, walnut joinery and glass pendant lights.

one-living.title: A one-bedroom living room
one-living.alt: A one-bedroom living room and kitchen at dusk, with a balcony over the valley.

one-bedroom.title: A one-bedroom bedroom
one-bedroom.alt: A bedroom with a slatted walnut wall, an upholstered bed and a window onto the hills.

one-kitchen.title: A one-bedroom kitchen
one-kitchen.alt: A compact kitchen in walnut and marble with an integrated refrigerator.

ph-living.title: Penthouse living and dining
ph-living.alt: Penthouse living and dining room under a walnut ceiling, with a sunset over Kigali beyond the glass.

ph-kitchen.title: The penthouse kitchen
ph-kitchen.alt: The penthouse kitchen with an island, walnut cabinetry and a lit staircase.

ph-bedroom.title: The penthouse master suite
ph-bedroom.alt: A penthouse master bedroom with a lit walk-in closet and a dusk view over the city.

ph-bath.title: The penthouse en-suite
ph-bath.alt: A marble en-suite with a freestanding stone bath in front of a window onto the hills at dusk.

ph-terrace.title: The penthouse roof terrace
ph-terrace.alt: A private roof terrace with an infinity pool and loungers, facing the sunset over Kigali.

view.title: The view west over Kigali
view.alt: The sun setting over the hills of Kigali, seen from the roof terrace.

plan-1br.title: One bedroom, furnished plan
plan-1br.alt: Indicative furnished plan of a one-bedroom residence: living and dining, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom and balcony.

plan-2br.title: Two bedroom, furnished plan
plan-2br.alt: Indicative furnished plan of a two-bedroom residence: living and dining, island kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony.

plan-ph.title: Penthouse, furnished plan
plan-ph.alt: Indicative furnished plan of a three-bedroom penthouse with a study and a wrap-around terrace.
